summary: Full E2E validation of the refactored Suppliers module (auto-derived eBay AU sellers), Items status/sort filters, Price Alerts sub-nav, eBay Scraper search/filter/sort, and Price History chart. 12/12 backend pytest cases pass; frontend flow covering Suppliers, Products/Price Alerts, eBay Scraper, ItemModal PriceHistory, and 8 other modules all load cleanly with no console errors. One tiny selector gap fixed by testing agent (added data-testid to single-point price history branch).
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 2636 lines — should be split into per-module files (Suppliers.jsx, ScraperPage.jsx, ProductsPage.jsx, PriceHistoryChart.jsx, nav config) for maintainability. Not blocking.

_build_sellers() in server.py runs an N+1 pattern (one products.find + one orders.aggregate per seller). Fine for the current 34 items / ~32 sellers but should be replaced with a single $lookup aggregation if seller count grows.
Scraper status filter 'all' option uses empty string value; that's fine but a select_option('all') from tests would fail — worth documenting or renaming to 'all'.
PriceHistoryChart single-point branch was missing data-testid — fixed by testing agent.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/App.js (added data-testid='price-history-chart' to single-point branch of PriceHistoryChart)
seed_data_creation: none — used existing 34 scraped items and demo seed data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_suppliers_and_items.py — use `pytest /app/backend/tests -v`. Suppliers are auto-derived from db.items on the fly; POST/PATCH/DELETE/import endpoints correctly return 405. GET /api/items now supports status=live|sold. Frontend: use data-testid selectors nav-scraper (not nav-ebay-scraper), sup-all/top/products/orders/activity, prd-all/low-stock/out-of-stock/price-alerts, scraper-search/status-filter/sort. Scraper status-filter 'all' option has value='' (empty string). Price History section is testable via data-testid='price-history-chart' in BOTH single-point and multi-point states after fix.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. Only micro-fix: single-point PriceHistoryChart branch lacked data-testid, added for test parity.
